english_translations.sahih_international: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?
english_translations.pickthall: Hast thou observed him who belieth religion?
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Seest thou one who denies the Judgment (to come)?
english_translations.shakir: Have you considered him who calls the judgment a lie?

ayahs.translation_bn: সে তো সেই (লোক) যে ইয়াতীমকে ধাক্কা দিয়ে সরিয়ে দেয়,
